commands.review_summary:
The PR changes `listControlledSubagentRuns` so a run is listed when either its stored `controllerSessionKey` or `requesterSessionKey` matches the caller key.

PR surface: Source +2. Total +2 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main writes separate controller and requester keys for spawned runs, and `/subagents` passes a resolved requester key into the exact list filter. I did not run a live Telegram reproduction in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The PR needs contributor-visible real behavior proof before merge, plus a small lint fix; the proof gate makes this human-handled rather than an automated repair candidate.
